{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Trey ran a variation on Lara Notsil's King of the Droids scam. He didn’t even know about Lara.|Voort saBinring to Sharr Latt|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''King of the droids''' ploy was an espionage tactic created by [[Lara Notsil]], a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>

==Concept==
{{Quote|It was invented by a teammate of mine and her astromech a long, long time ago. Before you gave your father his first gray hair. Each of your battery droids can reprogram and subvert simple droids, like housekeeping droids. Correct?|Voort saBinring to Myri Antilles|<ref name="MK" />}}
The tactic involved using one or several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to subvert other, simpler, droids - mostly [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|house-keeping]] and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance]] ones - to do what the controller wants them to, such as report on enemy movements or sabotage enemy machinery.<ref name="SC" />

==Application==
[[Lara Notsil]] first used this tactic when she was on [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s flagship, the [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']], using her [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] to capture and convert [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6 mouse droids]] on the ship, so they could disable the ship's hyperdrive to trap Zsinj when he was confronted by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces.<ref name="SC" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Trey Courser]] of the new [[Wraith Squadron|Wraiths]] investigating [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]], developed a similar tactic without knowing Notsil's. They used this tactic to infiltrate [[Borsk Fey'lya Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]] by disguising the droids as [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster cartridges]]. In order to speed things up, the Wraiths attacked the base's patrols and confiscated their weapons under the guise of the [[Quad-Linked Militant Pacifists]], a fictional terror group created for that purpose. This required new requisition orders for weapons which meant that the Wraith-modified weapons were issued to the patrols.<ref name="MK" />
